title: First day · "watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles" becomes a reader, a schedule and rows

steps.say: watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles
steps.reply:
I'm now watching We Work Remotely's back-end jobs for you. It checks every morning at 08:00 and tells you which roles are new and which have been taken down. The first check is at 08:00 today, or whenever your Mac next wakes after that.

The five roles listed right now are in **Job listings**, in a new **Job Search** area:

| Role | Company | Can work from | Posted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Senior Backend Developer (Python) | Proxify AB | Anywhere | ~19–20 Oct |
| Senior Backend Developer (Node.js / Nest.js) | Proxify AB | Anywhere | ~19–20 Oct |
| Staff Software Engineer, Revenue Systems | Square
